instruction: Pick up the lavender plastic shovel by 10 cm.

arguments.note: The lavender shovel is on the right, with its narrow shaft accessible. I will turn the right gripper downward before approaching the shaft.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The first rotation landed accurately. I will finish turning straight down so the jaws can straddle the shovel shaft.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The downward wrist view shows the shovel ahead of the grasp point. I will move above its narrow shaft, keeping clearance above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shaft is between the open jaws in the wrist view, and the approach landed accurately. I will lower toward it while retaining a little clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The closer view shows the handle loop under the hand and the narrow shaft farther back. I will shift toward the shaft before descending further.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The narrow shaft is now centered between the jaws. I will lower to just above its grasping height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shaft remains aligned and the last descent landed within 1 mm. I will lower another 5 mm to place the jaw faces around it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are aligned around the shovel shaft at grasp height. I will close them without moving the arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed around the shaft and remain partly open against it. I will lift a few millimetres first to check that the shovel follows.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shaft stayed secured during the initial lift. I will raise it another few millimetres to clear the shovel edges from the tabletop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shovel is following the gripper securely. I will lift vertically to raise it more than 10 cm above its starting height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper closed fully during the lift, and the shovel is no longer between the jaws. I will reopen to prepare a deeper, more secure grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The shovel has settled farther forward. I will realign above its shaft for a lower grasp that captures more than its upper edge.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The forward low target was unreachable. I will approach through a higher, nearer waypoint.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shaft is visible between the open jaws at the reachable waypoint. I will descend while keeping this lateral alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shaft remains aligned. I will descend in small increments to grasp its lower sides rather than the slippery top.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shovel has not shifted. I will lower another 5 mm for a deeper hold.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower another few millimetres, keeping the jaws clear of the tabletop and around the shaft.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shaft remains within the jaws. I will finish the deeper approach just above the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are now lower around the shaft than on the first attempt. I will close firmly at this height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The jaws are holding the lower shaft. I will start with a 5 mm test lift to verify that it stays captured.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shovel remains captured during the test lift. I will raise it another 6 mm to establish tabletop clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The deeper grasp remains stable. I will raise the shovel 3 cm and check for slipping before completing the lift.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The shovel is still held after the 3 cm lift. I will lift above 10 cm while drawing back slightly into the arm's reachable workspace.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
